death.note: He and the Sultan's daughter (whom he was intended to marry) died in the same year, 897 AH. The place of his death is not stated.

relation.note: He was a relative of the sultan of the time — in 897 AH al-Ashraf Qāytbāy — who promoted him and intended to marry him to his daughter.

state.label: نائب قلعة حلب
Nāʾib Qalʿat Ḥalab
state.note: Former commandant (nāʾib) of the Citadel of Aleppo (kāna = he formerly held it).

person.note: ジャーニム。かつてアレッポ城塞のナーイブ（城代）を務めた人物で、時のスルターンの近親であった。スルターンは彼を取り立て、自分の娘を彼に娶らせようとしたが、彼とその娘はともに897年に死去した。

Jānim, former commandant (nāʾib) of the Citadel of Aleppo, and a relative of the sultan of the time, who promoted him and intended to marry him to his daughter; but he and she both died in the year 897.
